date.description: Initial date/time when opening the dashboard; `now` opens it at the latest time on the dateStepSeconds grid before the current time

dateMax.description: Last date/time the dashboard offers; `now` for the current time

chartAxisRange.description: Min and max value for chart range when plotting values on a parametric chart

hidden.description: Keeps the filter for the charts and templates but shows no panel for it

key.description: Key name defining how to obtain the value from a GeoJSON Feature representing this filter, such as `path.to.variable.in.json`, evaluated relative to the `properties` of a GeoJSON Feature.

label.description: Label text shown in the chart

selectedValues.description: Initially selected values, use 'nan' for features w/o specification

stabilityIndex.description: Marks this filter as a snowpack stability index of the dry or the wet regime. While the markers are classified by a filter with this keyword, that filter drives the timeseries chart and its type fills the `stabilityIndex` request parameter and the `$stabilityIndex` placeholder in keys and templates. While a filter without the keyword classifies, or none does, the placeholder is filled by the default classifier (`default: classify`) if it carries the keyword, else by the first filter in the list that does.

url.description: URL to GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Timestamps in the format 2023-11-12_06-00-00 are evaluated.

label.description: Label string shown inside the marker

legend.description: Legend string shown in the chart, defaults to label

numericRange.description: An interval given as array of [lower bound, upper bound] where the lower bound is inclusive and the upper bound is exclusive

radius.description: Radius of the circle marker, in pixels

radiusByZoom.description: Radius of the circle marker, as array indexed by the map zoom level

zIndexOffset.description: The explicit zIndex of this marker

dormantMenu.description: On the datetag filter (type `datetag`): a menu in its chart header sets dates dormant. The filter and its chart stop offering a dormant date and count the features it drives as without specification; these stay on the map without a datetag marker label, and tooltips, the hazard chart and the timeseries keep the date. Every dashboard reads the list from `dormant_datetags.json` next to its config (when it cannot be read, nothing is dormant); only a dashboard with this flag shows the menu, which saves the list through `api/dormant-datetags`.

cuts.description: On the elevation filter (type `elevation`): one or two elevations in whole metres, ascending, that split its rows into bands; each must be a bound that two consecutive values share. While the filter is shown as a bar chart whose rows run from the highest down and fit the chart, a slider beside it moves the cuts from row bound to row bound (an end of the slider means no split), and a click between the cuts selects the rows of that band. A link carries cuts that differ from these as `cut`.

name.description: The recipe the source comes from, for instance tirol25: its folder under the simulation tree, its label in the source menu and its name in the API

group.description: Where the source sits in the source menu, nested with slashes such as Tirol/Gridded; top level when absent

url.description: URL to GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Timestamps in the format 2023-11-12_06-00-00 are evaluated.

detailsTemplates.description: Template for details HTML. The details are shown in the sidebar after clicking an marker on the map. Placeholders such as `{path.to.variable.in.json}` are evaluated relative to the `properties` of a GeoJSON Feature.

tooltipTemplate.description: Template for tooltip HTML. Tooltip is shown when hovering the marker on the map. Placeholders such as `{path.to.variable.in.json}` are evaluated relative to the `properties` of a GeoJSON Feature.

borderColor.description: Border stroke color of this source's markers, overrides the filter value's

borderWidth.description: Border stroke width of this source's markers, overrides the filter value's

borderDashArray.description: Border stroke dash-array of this source's markers, overrides the filter value's, see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/stroke-dasharray

imageOverlays.description: Image overlays to be shown on the map.

name.description: Identifier shown in map layer control

opacity.description: The opacity of the image overlay.

zIndex.description: The explicit zIndex of the overlay layer.

className.description: A custom class name to assign to the image. Empty by default.

mapCenter.description: Map center given as [latitude, longitude, zoom]

url.description: URL to GeoJSON FeatureCollection for micro-region polygons. For instance, https://regions.avalanches.org/micro-regions/latest/AT-07_micro-regions.geojson.json

xAxisLabels.description: Array of axis labels (indexed by the value)

frequencyBounds.description: Shares of a band's read slopes from which a stability class counts as a few (above few), some (from some) and many (above many), as rising numbers in [0, 1] that the publisher writes out from its named presets; the default preset when absent

sizePercentile.description: Percentile of the decisive class's size estimates taken as the size to reckon with (numpy's method lower), 50 for the median

dangerLevel.description: Offers the danger level view: a button beside the share button reads the selected features of every active source that have an aspect against the EAWS matrix, once per elevation band of the elevation filter's cuts, from the classifying stability index (else the default one) and the hazard chart's size, of which it reckons with the size percentile of the decisive class, shows the matrix in place of the hazard chart and paints the map by band. A feature whose snow depth snowpack.hs is 0 (no snow or no model output) is not read, a class counts as more than none from a share above few, and a band with one read slope gets a level; the frequency bounds and the size percentile are its only settings.
